definitions.explanation: Industrially produced fertilizer made from chemical compounds, as opposed to organic or natural fertilizers. A common topic in discussions about agriculture, environment, and food safety.

examples.japanese: {化学肥料|かがくひりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Farming that doesn't use chemical fertilizers is increasing.

examples.japanese: {化学肥料|かがくひりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使|し}いすぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{土壌|どじょう}→土壌：12040_dojou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}させる→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧。
examples.english: Overuse of chemical fertilizers degrades the soil.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{化学肥料|かがくひりょう}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{農薬|のうやく}→農薬：04295_nouyaku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}わ→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}てられた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: These vegetables were grown without chemical fertilizers or pesticides.

notes:
USAGE:
Often contrasted with ⟦{有機肥料|ゆうきひりょう}→有機肥料：26530_yuukihiryou⟧ (organic fertilizer). Commonly discussed in the context of {有機農業|ゆうきのうぎょう} (organic farming) and food labeling. Often abbreviated to {化肥|かひ} in agricultural contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {化学肥料|かがくひりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use chemical fertilizer)
- {化学肥料|かがくひりょう}⟦{不使用|ふしよう}→不使用：29835_fushiyou⟧ (chemical-fertilizer-free)
- {化学肥料|かがくひりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧ (to rely on chemical fertilizers)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有機肥料|ゆうきひりょう}→有機肥料：26530_yuukihiryou⟧: organic fertilizer
- ⟦{農薬|のうやく}→農薬：04295_nouyaku⟧: pesticide, agricultural chemical
